CFML Language Reference: Functions

Abs

Returns the absolute value of a number, that is, the number without its sign. Positive numbers and zero come back unchanged; negative numbers come back positive.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Abs(number)

Parameters

number
Any number, or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number greater than or equal to zero.

Usage

Handy for differences where only the size matters, such as "how far off budget are we" or the number of days between two dates in either order. Use Sgn if you need the sign instead.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Values = "42,-42,0,-3.75,1999">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Abs(number)</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="#Values#">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Abs(n)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

Sgn, Int, Fix, Round
